Groups
Let \(G\) be a group.
A group \(G\) is called cyclic if there exists \(a\in G\) such that
\[
G=\langle a\rangle.
\]


Analysis
For \(f\in L^1(\mathbb{R})\), define its Fourier transform by
\[
\widehat f(\xi)
=
\int_{\mathbb{R}}
f(x)e^{-2\pi i x\xi}\,dx.
\]
We also have
\[
\left\|f\right\|_{L^2}^2
=
\int_{\mathbb{R}} |f(x)|^2\,dx.
\]
